messages.subject: Dashboard - images loading when not displayed
parts:
Hi all,

I am running a dashboard to present my AB test results, see link below
https://moonpig.shinyapps.io/ABDashboard/

This dashboard contains several tabs and screenshots of the variations I m running, as we are running more and more tests, the weight of the dashboard page is increasingly exponentially as the images are quite heavy.
Every time someone opens the dashboard, it results in downloading all the images in the background to render the dashboard, where most people are only interested looking at the current test.
My question the following:
Is there a way to download the images only when the tab is being open, so people accessing the dashboard on slow connection/mobile don't have to experience a slow loading experience?

Thanks
G
